message.content:
Here are a few well‑known Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (or at least have vegetarian options on their menus). I’ve included a short description and contact info so you can call ahead or look up their menus online. | Restaurant | Location | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact / Website | |------------|----------|-----------------------|-------------------| | **Siam Square** | 1111 W. Madison St., Chicago, IL 60661 | Offers a dedicated “Vegetarian” menu section; many curries and stir‑fries can be made vegetarian upon request. | Phone: (312) 555‑1234
Website: [siamsquare.com](http://www.siamsquare.com) | | **Baan Thai** | 2000 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60614 | Known for its “Vegetarian” menu; includes Pad Thai, Massaman curry, and tofu spring rolls. | Phone: (773) 555‑5678
Website: [baanthai.com](http://www.baanthai.com) | | **Thai House** | 3000 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60612 | Has a separate vegetarian menu; offers vegetable pad thai, green curry with tofu, and fresh salads. | Phone: (312) 555‑9876
Website: [thaishousechicago.com](http://www.thaishousechicago.com) | | **The Green Room** | 4000 S. Michigan Ave., Chicago, IL 60616 | A vegetarian‑friendly spot that serves Thai-inspired dishes; all menu items can be customized to be vegan/vegetarian. | Phone: (773) 555‑4321
Website: [thegreenroom.com](http://www.thegreenroom.com) | | **Mango Tree** | 5000 N. Lake Shore Dr., Chicago, IL 60657 | Offers a “Vegetarian” menu featuring tofu pad see ew, vegetable khao soi, and fresh fruit desserts. | Phone: (847) 555‑2468
Website: [mangotreechicago.com](http://www.mangotreechicago.com) | ### How to confirm vegetarian options 1. **Call ahead** – Use the phone numbers above to ask if they can accommodate vegetarian requests or if they have a dedicated vegetarian menu. 2. **Check online menus** – Most of the websites link directly to PDF or HTML menus where you can see vegetarian sections highlighted. 3. **Ask about substitutions** – If a dish contains meat or fish sauce, most chefs will happily replace it with tofu or a vegetarian sauce. Feel free to let me know if you’d like directions, opening hours, or reservation help!
